reader.notes: FirstLineTarget's body arm returns FIRST DETAIL for the first body group on a page and LINE-COUNTER + integer otherwise; the LC >= FIRST DETAIL / no-body-yet arm of 4b (LC + 1) is taken by PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup, returning saved + 1. On a legal 85 report LINE-COUNTER can stand at or past FIRST DETAIL with no body group on the page only through the saved integer (a report or page heading must end before FIRST DETAIL, §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR2a, 3.10.7 GR2), so the two code arms cover the rule. A heading that overruns its lower limit would get FIRST DETAIL where the letter of 4b gives LC + 1; that input breaks a lower limit rule.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-145/q1_saved_plus0.cob (runs/q1_saved_plus0-001 at --std 85, -002 at --std 2023): RD PAGE 20 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 LAST DETAIL 18 FOOTING 18; DE-A LINE PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP 5; DE-B LINE PLUS 0; DE-C LINE PLUS 1. GENERATE DE-A twice (lines 3 and 6; the second leaves LC 18 = FOOTING and saves 5 under 6a), then GENERATE DE-B, DE-C. Printed at 85: 'BEFORE DE-B LINE-COUNTER 18 PAGE-COUNTER 1', 'AFTER DE-B LINE-COUNTER 06 PAGE-COUNTER 2', DEB on PAGE 2 LINE 06, DEC on PAGE 2 LINE 07; 2023 identical. The 1985 text: when DE-B is processed a body group HAS been presented on page 1, so fit test 3b's first paragraph applies (the saved-integer paragraph is only for 'If no body group has yet been presented'): trial 18 + 0 = 18 is not greater than LAST DETAIL 18, so DE-B stays on page 1, and GR4b's second arm places it at LINE-COUNTER + integer = 18 + 0 = line 18; the saved 5 is still set, so DE-C (trial 19 > 18) advances, takes LC 5 and lands on page 2 line 6. Expected DEB p1 l18, DEC p2 l6; observed DEB p2 l6, DEC p2 l7. LINE PLUS 0 as a first LINE is legal 1985 source (SR1 'Integer-2 may be zero'; line 18 is inside the detail region 3..18). The code keys the GR4b arm on _nextGroupSave != 0 (PresentBody -> PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup, which advances unconditionally, then returns saved + 1) instead of on whether a body group is on the page, so the second arm of 4b is never reached while the save location is set. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR4  (3.10.8 Body Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR4' (quoting 'presented on the line that is obtained by adding the content of LINE-COUNTER and the integer of the first LINE NUMBER clause of the current body group'); 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3  ... the text is in GR3' (quoting 'If a body group has been presented on the page to which the report is currently positioned, the RWCS computes a trial sum in a work location'); 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1  ... the text is in SR1' ('Integer-2 may be zero'); 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR6 ... the text is in GR6'. kb/Work search (PLUS 0 / zero with saved next group; PB5245, PB1247): no note covers it.

refuter.corrected: Not CONFORMS: wrong-answer at --std 85, cause (a) (1985 needs its own arm: the 2023 forced advance is applied to 1985). A relative body group whose LINE integers are all zero, following a body group whose absolute NEXT GROUP filled the save location, belongs on the current page at LINE-COUNTER (the FOOTING line) by GR3b + GR4b second arm; the compiler moves it to the next page at saved + 1. The primary broken rule is the fit test §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3 (1985-GR-XIII.3.10.8-3), GR4's second arm being the placement it never reaches; file it there with this rule as the consequence.
